saw_lines: Shoppers with sensitive skin don’t browse. They check each label for fragrance, then reorder the one product that suits them.
So the sale is decided on the results page, where a headline tells a shopper if a $25 product is worth it.
Your 8 Google text ads are the only paid copy we can see, so put the Under $25 range from your site into the next batch.
ads_1: Google text ads built on the under $25 range and fragrance-free claims
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
